_note: Store asset specs. Stores change these; every entry carries lastVerified and a source so a stale number is auditable rather than silently wrong. Anything with verified:false must be confirmed in the store console before upload.

rules.note: Only the largest size in each family is required. Apple scales those down for smaller devices, so a 6.9" iPhone set and a 13" iPad set cover the whole listing.

dynamicIsland._note: A simulator capture already contains the island, drawn black in the status bar. Only draw one when the source screen does not have it.

ipad-13.label: iPad 13"
ipad-13.required: only if the app supports iPad

previews._note: App previews are video. Up to 3 per localization.

ipad-13.label: iPad 13" preview
ipad-13.confirmBefore: Not verified against Apple's current spec page. Check the source URL and confirm before uploading an iPad preview.

rules.aspectRule: longest side no more than twice the shortest
rules.note: Play does not scale one set across form factors. Tablet screenshots must show a real tablet layout, not an upscaled phone.

feature-graphic.label: Feature graphic
feature-graphic.note: Required for every Play listing. No transparency, and avoid putting essential text near the edges since it gets cropped in some placements.

_cornerNote: cornerExtentRatio is how far the display's continuous corner curve runs before the straight edge starts, as a fraction of screen width. It is NOT a border-radius: an iPhone corner is a continuous curve built from bezier segments, and no circular radius matches it. Where Xcode is present, scripts/device-mask.mjs reads the exact outline from Apple's own artwork. cornerRadiusFallbackRatio is the closest circular approximation, for machines without Xcode, and should be reported as approximate.

fastlane.note: deliver picks files up in sorted filename order, so prefix with a number to control the order shown on the listing.
